text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened during an outing with North 
Flight. While walking through the shopping 
mall—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm…… What should I do…… I wonder what 
everyone thinks~……"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh—hello, Mirako-san♪ Is something the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Flight-chan! You see, I was thinking about 
going clothes shopping, but~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—I have no clothes to wear to go buy 
clothes~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle explained the situation to 
me with an urgent expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping, I went over in front 
of the clothing store, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There are so many stylish girls here, it's 
making me nervous...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought going in there might be a bit 
impossible for me~...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I see, I see—got it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Could you follow me for a 
moment, then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If there were a way to solve the dilemma 
of 'having no clothes to wear when going 
out to buy clothes'—
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if Flight will go buy it for 
me?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those thoughts in mind, I followed 
along. And the place we arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Here is a fast-fashion boutique!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, this is that famous...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I believe many people have seen the 
logo before.
choice_data_list: What are we supposed to do here?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We'd love it if Mirako-san could do some 
shopping over here♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In fast fashion stores, the staff almost 
never come up to talk to you, so—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Many people focus on practicality, so 
customers rarely pay much mind to one 
another.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Plus, we have seasonal items that would 
look great on anyone, so you definitely 
won't leave empty-handed!♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're right, everyone's just looking at 
the products and not really paying 
attention to each other..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“No one's looking at me either, so... 
—Alright, here I go!”
choice_data_list: (I see... So that's how to solve it.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd be delighted if this helps 
resolve your worries♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer, is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
No, I just assumed you were going to buy 
it.

No, I just assumed you were going to buy 
it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. Indeed, that might just be the 
easiest way.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's no guarantee that I'll be 
able to do the same thing next time, 
right?”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then we must help them take action for 
themselves. For their own sake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see— It seems this choice was intended 
to encourage independence in others.
choice_data_list:
You're really thinking about what's best 
for that child, aren't you?

You're really considering that child's own 
feelings, aren't you?
I hope she can shine even brighter.

It'd be great if she could shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I see— It seems this choice was intended 
to encourage independence in others.
choice_data_list:
You're really thinking about what's best 
for that child, aren't you?

You're really considering that child's own 
feelings, aren't you?
I hope she can shine even brighter.

It'd be great if she could shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I believe the future will be even 
brighter once you're able to take action 
on your own♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought that her way of thinking was 
something I, as a Trainer, ought to learn 
from.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, upon returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I hope so too. I'm looking forward to 
Miracle-san's future even more now♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In her considerate attitude toward others, 
one could glimpse both kindness and 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, upon returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you bought new clothes~! They look so 
fresh and nice♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, told you so~♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thank goodness. Looks like it 
went well♪
